meta.library_note: 25 power plant construction modules for data center prime and bridge power, authored by VissRad. Demonstration norms, not market or benchmark data: calibrate to your own history before a plan is issued.

event.name: Campus Power Plant, 380 MW behind the meter (synthetic demo)

units.name: Balance of plant, water and pipe rack
MV feeders to the data halls

materials.desc: Carbon steel pipe, 8 in average, with fittings
Fuel gas pipe, 12 in, with fittings
Rigid conduit and fittings, per ft
Spiral wound gasket, CS/316, per inch dia
Instrument fittings, tubing and parts allowance
Pipe insulation and jacketing, per inch-dia foot
Carbon steel pipe, per inch-dia foot
Gate valve, flanged, per inch-class factor
Fire-water pipe, HDPE / ductile iron, installed materials

modules.name: Mobilization and temporary facilities
modules.desc: Mobilize the power plant site next to the data center campus: offices, laydown and heavy-haul route, crane pads, temporary power and water, security and the site-specific safety plan.

queries.prompt: Heavy-haul route and crane pads needed?

tasks.desc: Execution plan, permits and site safety plan

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Site preparation and grading
modules.desc: Clearing, mass grading, stormwater and the plant roads and pads, with aggregate surfacing of the equipment yards.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Underground utilities and grounding
modules.desc: Below-grade systems before foundations: grounding grid, MV duct banks to the data hall, fuel gas and water lines, fire water loop and drains.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Piling and equipment foundations
modules.desc: Piles where the soils need them, then the large equipment foundations: engine and turbine blocks, generator and transformer pads, BESS and fuel cell pads, stacks and pipe rack footings.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Engine hall and plant buildings
modules.desc: Pre-engineered engine hall or turbine enclosure building, control building, warehouse and the crane rails inside the engine hall.

queries.prompt: Overhead bridge crane in the engine hall?

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Reciprocating engine generator sets
modules.desc: Large gas engine gensets (roughly 5 to 20 MW each) set in the engine hall or as containerized units: set and align engine and generator, couple, and hook up charge air, lube oil and cooling water.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Engine auxiliaries, exhaust and stacks
modules.desc: Radiator banks, exhaust silencers and stacks, SCR and oxidation catalyst housings, lube oil and urea systems, ventilation for the engine hall.

tasks.desc: SCR and catalyst housings, urea system
Lube oil, ventilation and fire protection

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Aeroderivative gas turbine packages
modules.desc: Packaged aeroderivative or mobile gas turbines (roughly 25 to 50 MW each): set the turbine and generator modules, inlet filter house, exhaust and stack, auxiliary skids, and interconnect.

tasks.desc: Inlet filter house, exhaust and stack
Auxiliary skids, interconnect piping and wiring

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Industrial frame gas turbine
modules.desc: Small or medium frame gas turbine generator (roughly 50 to 300 MW): set the turbine and generator with heavy lift or jacking, align, lube and seal oil, inlet and exhaust systems, and auxiliaries.

tasks.desc: Inlet house, exhaust diffuser and stack
Lube oil, fuel and auxiliary systems

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Heat recovery steam generator
modules.desc: HRSG for a later steam cycle behind the gas turbines: set modules, casing and duct work, drums, harps, stack, then pressure-part welding, hydrotest and the SCR / CO sections.

tasks.desc: Set modules and casing ({MOD} per unit)
Insulation, lagging and SCR / CO catalyst

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Steam turbine generator
modules.desc: Steam turbine and generator for the combined cycle: set on the pedestal, align, lube oil system, high-energy piping from the HRSG, steam blows and turbine restoration.

tasks.desc: Align, couple and lube oil system

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Air-cooled condenser or cooling tower
modules.desc: Heat rejection for the steam cycle: air-cooled condenser streets (the common choice where water is scarce near data center campuses) or a mechanical-draft cooling tower with circulating water.

queries.prompt: ACC fan cells or tower cells

tasks.desc: ACC tube bundles, steam duct and fans
Tower fill, fans and circ water piping

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Solid-oxide fuel cell power blocks
modules.desc: Fuel cell power modules set on pads in blocks, with fuel gas, water and electrical connections and the block power electronics, commissioned module by module.

tasks.desc: Electrical connections and block power electronics

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Battery energy storage
modules.desc: Containerized BESS that buffers data center load swings and gives ride-through: enclosures on pads, power conversion systems, MV transformers and collection, fire detection, and the battery management system.

tasks.desc: DC and AC cabling and terminations

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Solar array
modules.desc: Ground-mounted solar supplementing the campus: piles, single-axis trackers, modules, DC strings and combiners, inverters and MV collection.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Fuel gas yard
modules.desc: Fuel gas from the pipeline tap: metering and regulating station, filter separators, heaters, gas compressors where pipeline pressure is too low for the turbines, and distribution to each unit.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Balance-of-plant mechanical and piping
modules.desc: Pipe rack, water treatment and storage, compressed air, fire protection and the BOP piping between systems, with hydrotests and insulation.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Generator step-up and auxiliary transformers
modules.desc: Generator step-up transformers to the plant bus, unit auxiliary transformers, oil fill and processing, and the isolated-phase or cable bus from each generator.

tasks.desc: Generator bus duct or cable bus

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: High-voltage switchyard and interconnect
modules.desc: The plant switchyard: breakers, disconnects, bus and structures, control house and relay panels, and the tie to the utility or the campus substation.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: MV distribution to the data hall
modules.desc: Plant MV switchgear and E-houses, and the MV feeders from the power plant to the data center substations, with terminations and VLF testing.

tasks.desc: Set E-houses and MV switchgear ({SECT} sections)

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Plant electrical: raceway, cable and lighting
modules.desc: Cable tray and conduit, LV power and control cable to every unit and auxiliary, motor connections, grounding connections, lighting and receptacles.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Plant controls, microgrid controller and SCADA
modules.desc: Plant DCS or PLC, unit control panels, the microgrid / power management controller that dispatches engines, turbines, fuel cells and BESS against data center load, SCADA to the utility, CEMS, and instruments with loop checks.

tasks.desc: Microgrid controller configuration and factory-to-site tests

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Pre-commissioning and system turnover
modules.desc: Construction to commissioning by system: walkdowns and punch lists, electrical testing and backfeed, flushing and cleaning, instrument air and fuel gas purge, and system turnover packages.

tasks.desc: Clear punch and turn over systems

modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: First fire, synchronization and tuning
modules.desc: Unit by unit: first fire or first start, full speed no load, synchronize to the plant bus, load in steps, combustion and emissions tuning, protection checks.
modules.author: VissRad

modules.name: Performance, emissions and data center load tests
modules.desc: Prove the plant can carry the data hall: capacity and heat rate tests, stack testing and CEMS certification, block-load and load-step acceptance with load banks, islanding and grid transfer tests with the microgrid controller, then a reliability run.

queries.prompt: Load bank tests before the IT load is ready?

tasks.desc: Commercial operation and turnover to the data center
